You are implementing Task 4: bedrock — `finish()` returns a `Vec` and a terminal guard.

This is task 4 of 7 for SMA-863 (the anthropic and bedrock stream translators emit no ToolCallDelta for a tool call with no input delta). Tasks 1-3 fixed anthropic. Tasks 4-6 do bedrock; this task prepares the bedrock translator (`crates/paigasus-helikon-providers-bedrock/src/stream.rs`) for them. It adds no ToolCallDelta behaviour.

## Read first
1. Your brief — your requirements, with exact values to use verbatim: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-25-sma-863-zero-delta-tool-call/task-4-brief.md
2. Global constraints: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-25-sma-863-zero-delta-tool-call/global-constraints.md
3. Background only if needed: spec §6.2 "Terminal guard" and §6.3 in /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-25-sma-863-zero-delta-tool-call-design.md

## Context and decisions
- The anthropic crate made the same `finish()` change in Task 1: it returns `Vec<Result<ModelEvent, ModelError>>`, and its driver uses `for ev in translator.finish() { yield ev; }`. Gemini's driver (`crates/paigasus-helikon-providers-gemini/src/model.rs` ~L150) has the same form. Match it.
- Today `finish()` keeps only the first item of `finish_events` (`.into_iter().next()`). After this task it returns all of them.
- `terminal_emitted` is set in two places: (a) inside `finish_events` when it returns a non-empty Vec (a `Finish` or the both-tools `Err`); (b) where the refused tool call (`forbid_tool_calls`) pushes its `Err` in the `ContentBlockStart` arm. Nothing reads the flag yet; Task 5 adds the reader (the `ContentBlockStop` early return). Do NOT add any reader in this task. If clippy warns that the field is never read, add a one-line `// Read by the ContentBlockStop arm (SMA-863 Task 5).` comment and, only if still needed, `#[allow(dead_code)]` on the field with that comment — report it.
- Do not change the existing behaviour on any path: the same events in the same order for every existing test.
- Tests 1-3 are unit tests in the module's `mod tests`, so they can read the private field. Use the existing helpers (`tool_use_start`, `tool_delta`, `content_block_stop`, `message_start`, `message_stop`, `metadata`, `run`, `tool_call_names`).

## Working rules
Work from /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863 (git worktree, branch feature/sma-863-anthropic-and-bedrock-emit-no-toolcalldelta). Start every shell command with `cd /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863 || exit 1`. Absolute paths with that root for Read/Edit/Write. NEVER git checkout, switch, reset, stash, rebase, or `git add -A`.
Work synchronously in the foreground; never background cargo; do not end until each command finishes.
TDD: write the tests, record RED (compile failure expected), implement, record GREEN. Record the bedrock test count before and after. Before committing run the full bedrock suite, `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-provider-stream-conformance`, `cargo fmt --all`, and `cargo clippy -p paigasus-helikon-providers-bedrock --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
Ask now if unclear; if stuck report BLOCKED / NEEDS_CONTEXT with specifics. You do not dispatch subagents. Self-review your diff.

## Report
Full report (implementation, RED/GREEN evidence with commands and output, files changed, concerns) to: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-25-sma-863-zero-delta-tool-call/task-4-report.md
